insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Dispatch Capabilities
insights.finding: Jeppesen showcased product feature updates for its ForeFlight platform by introducing new Airflow agents designed for operational briefing and trip feasibility.
insights.aviation_context: Business and commercial flight dispatchers utilize automated trip planning modules to streamline pre-flight preparation.
insights.caveat: Announcements at industry events represent feature releases but do not confirm widespread operational uptake.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Deploys Flight Planning and EFB Solutions
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems secured implementation milestones for its Lido Flight 4D and Lido mPilot products with carriers including Kenya Airways and Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Airlines integrate digital flight planning and iOS-based electronic flight bag applications to manage aeronautical data and flight paths.
insights.caveat: Captured highlights represent specific customer wins publicized by the vendor rather than universal market share.
